findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping in document lookups
findings.body: When IDs are tenant-scoped or can collide, `getDocument` now drops `ctx.tenantId` and `loadDocument` queries only by `documentId`, so a request can return another tenant's document. Keep the tenant argument and include it in the database predicate to preserve isolation.

findings.title: [P2] Retain a compatible cache module
findings.body: Deleting the exported `src/cache.ts` module breaks existing consumers at module resolution/compile time. Because the PR explicitly claims to preserve existing contracts and no replacement or migration is provided, retain a compatibility export or update the public contract and consumers together.
